scenes.anchor_text: “Above silence, the illuminating storms—dying storms— illuminate the silence above.”
scenes.scene_description: A vast landscape under the dying roiling storm, revealing the vast silence above. The light is fading, but still strong enough to illuminate the surreal landscape.
